production_conditions: Production deployments use PostgreSQL rather than SQLite.
The container runs non-root with no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities and a read-only root filesystem.
The image is rebuilt with --pull and --no-cache before release scanning.
Both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 manifests are scanned.
The final production image is pinned by registry sha256 digest.
The acceptance is temporary and must be re-evaluated no later than valid_until or when Debian publishes a fix.
